biggest_catch: The 5% applies to the total sale including shipping — set shipping charges fairly, because they inflate the fee base.
catches: Official: 5% selling fee on total sale amount (including shipping) + 3.19% + $0.49 payment processing = 8.19% + $0.49 total on US sales.
Selling fee capped at $500 (sales over $10,000) — the best cap in the industry.
Unlimited free listings; pay only when it sells.
PayPal orders incur PayPal's own processing fee on top, separate from Reverb's.
Cross-border fee 1% (outside EEA); 2.5% currency conversion if payout currency differs.
First-time sellers paid ~5 business days after delivery; existing sellers 5 business days after item is in transit.

eligibility: Anyone 18+ with musical instruments or gear
maximize: Use the Reverb Price Guide before listing — price is the #1 predictor of sale speed, and Reverb buyers research comps. The $500 fee cap makes Reverb the cheapest platform for expensive gear: a $15,000 guitar costs $500 here vs. much more on eBay. Avoid PayPal checkout when possible since its separate processing fee stacks on top of Reverb's. Qualify for Preferred Seller status (2.99% + $0.49 processing) once your volume supports it. Music gear sells to an expert audience here, so detailed condition notes and demos beat pretty photos — write the listing like a gearhead, not a marketer.
